claim_text: A gas multi-channel has 1/60 pre-release triggered files over 35 minutes aggregate background
limitations: does not estimate full-day site false-alarm rate

claim_text: All 13 days have identical CO reference at all 100 corresponding settled segments
evidence_kind: original UCI487 laboratory data read-only diagnostic
scope: 13 measurement days x 100 repeated experimental segments
limitations: The time-only lookup is invalid as a gas estimator; no physical site data

scope: same chamber and repeated 0-20ppm schedule; three days and 20 unseen positions

claim_text: Validation-chosen heater-separated 14-sensor plus ambient ridge scored 0.530 ppm test MAE
scope: same chamber, fixed schedule, known levels, last 300s of 15-minute segments

claim_text: Daily zero-CO R1 low-heater medians range approximately 2.74-8.45 MOhm across 13 lab days
scope: same gas chamber and repeated stimulus program
limitations: Humidity and previous exposure may contribute; no causal attribution to aging

claim_text: With one fixed synthetic overlap path 58/60 prior laboratory gas test files yield at least one simulated L3 interval
evidence_kind: UCI309 measured laboratory gas + fixed simulated personnel
scope: 60 already viewed fixed-onset wind tunnel trials with one reused artificial corridor trajectory
limitations: Counts are scenario coverage and timing, not accident prediction performance

claim_text: At fixed 1m buffer and 3s gas evidence adding 0.5m simulated position error bound changes L3 simulated seconds from 2664 to 842 and flags 2460 of 12900 replayed seconds unknown
evidence_kind: UCI309 measured laboratory gas + simulated spatial perturbation
scope: same 60 prior gas trials and one synthetic path / single seeded noise draw
limitations: 0.5m is not D435 measured error; 2460 time points are 41 synthetic positions replicated 60 times

claim_text: Wrong-zone simulated pairing yields unknown joint output for all 10 injected seconds in each of 60 gas replays
evidence_kind: software policy property under synthetic fault injection
scope: deterministic zone mismatch with independent gas and person events retained
limitations: Implementation property by construction, not empirical safety performance

claim_text: Within the held-out later time blocks the frozen multi-channel score alarms within 60 s after 14/14 CO and 13/13 methane gas-delivery setpoint onsets; single-channel CO misses 14/14
evidence_kind: laboratory gas-chamber sensor measurements and controlled source setpoint schedule
scope: two separate continuous chamber runs; chronological time holdouts
limitations: Correlated repeated setpoints; only 0.246/0.461 h conservative zeros; no coke-plant accident or actual concentration trace

claim_text: One SB112 smoke sensor has 6 alarm episodes within 23.978 covered hours on a day without manual triggering; other three sensor channels have zero episodes under their own thresholds
evidence_kind: smart-building sensor logged values with author-described no-manual-trigger days
limitations: No independently annotated ambient hazard truth or exact stimulus onset; not a coke-plant false-alarm estimate

claim_text: CO B0 frozen sensor-channel scores during 14 original test setpoint onsets never reach its 32.408 threshold (max 0.8785)
scope: same Stage7A laboratory held-out time block
limitations: After seeing 7A results; physical failure cause not established; not a new blind test

claim_text: Preselected SSDLite matched 62 of 66 human person boxes in 115 sampled frames of two similar Bonn indoor videos at IoU 0.5
evidence_kind: public indoor RGB with assembled independently reviewed 2D boxes
scope: two similar indoor sequences; second visible during annotation QC
limitations: Does not validate D435 or coke-plant personnel detection

claim_text: After A1 and G1 freeze 32 of 34 human-person frames in the second indoor sequence yielded a detector-box depth; two were 2D misses
evidence_kind: public indoor RGB-D depth availability; internal quality gate
scope: 57 sampled frames in similar indoor room; 34 human-labeled person frames

claim_text: Frozen G1 yields 2 inside 1 near 29 outside and 2 unknown across 34 human-person frames in a similar indoor sequence
scope: self-defined X=0.15 and 0.35 m imaginary boundaries for torso point
